title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1971-12-02
source: Source Info: FM Broadcast (WBCN Boston); Master Reel to Reel > Matt Smith's 1st generation Reels; Transfer Info: 1st generation reels ((Technics RS-1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.0 24/96 > TLH flac2496; This is a 16/44 fileset. 24-bit > 16-bit via dBpoweramp

ai_review.summary: Rich, crisp FM broadcast soundboard capture of a fun, long 1971 show with clear vocals and lively banter.
ai_review.review: The FM broadcast delivers a lush, lustrous mix that is crystal‑clear once the opening songs settle into the board balance. Vocals shine, instruments are well separated, and the band’s humorous asides – including Phil’s “Lemme get my glasses” moment – make for an engaging listening experience. Pigpen’s presence adds to the long, enjoyable outing.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed five‑star review praises both the musical performance and the high‑quality broadcast mix; lack of multiple reviews limits confidence but overall rating is strong.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rich, lustrous and crisp sound with clear vocals and well‑separated instruments after the opening songs settle; minor comment that early tracks needed board mix adjustment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long outing filled with humorous band banter and audience interaction; overall fun atmosphere highlighted by Pigpen’s participation.

band_member_comments.Phil: Notable onstage joke – “Lemme get my glasses.”
